items.title: ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder, CALIBRATED: does the dACC goal-readout channel route precision once dacc_goal_readout_weight/normalize are actually set? (successor to V3-EXQ-848)
items.note: Bug-fix/calibration lettered successor to V3-EXQ-848 (ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder, FAIL/mixed 4/10 units, rho up to 0.866). 848's _agent_kwargs() never set dacc_goal_readout_weight, so it silently defaulted to 0.0 and the SD-057 L7 dACC goal-readout term (ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py DACCtoE3Adapter.forward(), gated on grw!=0.0) contributed EXACTLY ZERO to score_bias throughout 848's run -- the channel-1 dACC-consume pathway 848 was designed to test was never engaged; 848's observed signal is attributable to channel 1's pre-existing serotonin pathway and channel 2, not the dACC-consume mechanism. A follow-up direct probe (session IGW-20260801-199 / arc005_dacc_adapter_goal_proximity_training, instrumenting REEAgent.select_action on 848's own driver config) found this gap plus a units/calibration mismatch in raw candidate_goal_proximity (small achieved cross-candidate spread ~0.003-0.03 vs full [0,1] nominal range, because GoalState.goal_proximity()'s MSE-sum distance is dominated by the larger e2_world_forward candidate-summary norm rather than genuine goal-relative displacement -- a calibration issue, not an untrained consumer; DACCtoE3Adapter has no nn.Parameter anywhere). Both fixed on ree-v3 main commit 4b79d18d44 (SD-057 L7 amend): DACCConfig.dacc_goal_readout_normalize (new, default False, bit-identical off) does a per-candidate-set min-max rescale before the existing dacc_goal_readout_weight multiply. This successor sets dacc_goal_readout_weight=0.5 (V3-EXQ-637 precedent value) and dacc_goal_readout_normalize=True; every other design element (channel-1/2-only ladder, channels 3/4 fixed at L0, content sets, arena, schedule, seeds, the pre-registered C_PRECISION_MONOTONICITY criterion and its thresholds) is UNCHANGED from 848. Adds a build-time guard (asserts cfg.dacc_goal_readout_weight/normalize threaded through REEConfig.from_dims correctly, and agent.dacc_adapter.config carries them) plus a whole-run engagement check (agent.dacc_adapter._n_bias_calls must increment at least once across the run) specifically to prevent a repeat of 848's silent-zero failure mode. Substrate readiness: SD-057 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md); the L7 wiring fix is on main. Re-derive brake checked: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag ARC-005 -- not braked. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (precision monotonicity with the calibrated dACC goal-readout channel genuinely engaged) does not exist in any recorded manifest -- 848's manifest ran with the channel silently inert, not a compatible substrate_hash for this question; not recoverable by reanalysis. supersedes: V3-EXQ-848 per the EXQ lettering convention's bug-fix rule, though 848's manifest evidence is not discarded -- see the script's SUPERSEDES_NOTE for why governance review should read both results together rather than treat 848 as invalidated outright. Smoke --dry-run PASS (12 cells at dry scale): all verdicts PASS, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.130 writer_calls=600 -- no writer defect, build-time guards held, total_dacc_bias_calls=492 (engagement check passed), result at dry scale is a near-zero null (all_near_zero_null=true) -- not scored at dry scale, informative only that the pipeline runs end-to-end without error. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all checks.
items.supersedes_note: Bug-fix/calibration lettered iteration correcting 848's omitted dacc_goal_readout_weight (silently defaulted to 0.0, so the dACC goal-readout term never engaged in 848's run) and adding dacc_goal_readout_normalize=True (ree-v3 commit 4b79d18d44). Same design, same criterion as 848 otherwise.

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction). COMPUTE COST -- FLAGGED EXPLICITLY, deliberate user judgment call (2026-08-01, chip-20260801-859-full-replication): this is a real ~7.7-HOUR compute commitment. Accepted because V3-EXQ-858 (ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B, a 1200-minute/20-hour 4-rung f_weight attenuation ladder run) is ALREADY sitting suspended pending exactly this question -- the cost of running this once is smaller than leaving that allocation suspended indefinitely on an ambiguous short-probe result. THIS RESULT DETERMINES WHETHER V3-EXQ-858 CAN BE UNBLOCKED: V3-EXQ-858's own matched-stack config presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under lateral_pfc routing, which is exactly what is in question here. NOTE (observed at queue time, 2026-08-01): the current experiment_queue.json snapshot shows V3-EXQ-858 status='claimed' on ree-cloud-4 since 2026-08-01T12:44:33Z, not 'suspended' -- a coordinator-side hold/suspend action may not be reflected in this git-derived queue view (holds are coordinator-side per CLAUDE.md 'Phase-3 queue lever depends on op'); flagged for the user/governance to reconcile, not resolved by this queue entry. Code review (Step 3.5): script is a near-verbatim merge of V3-EXQ-859's agent config + MECH-448/449 latch-cleared readout (copied unchanged) with V3-EXQ-851's P0/P1/P2 phase structure + REINFORCE bias-head training machinery (copied unchanged, constants LR_LPFC_BIAS/ REINFORCE_BATCH_SIZE/OUTCOME_BUF_MAX/POLICY_TEMPERATURE/ADV_MIN_THRESHOLD/EMA_DECAY reused verbatim from 851). claim tagging, diagnostic adjudication (one readiness precondition, measured/threshold/met, load_bearing sample_adequate criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for both mechanisms), substrate API correctness, latch-clearing, progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=350 the loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*arm = 6 lines, Seed/ Condition boundary lines), output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator), runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through) all verified against current source. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = MECH-448/449 engagement under lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source at FULL training budget, matched seeds. Checked: V3-EXQ-851 tested lateral_pfc alone (matched constant, not swept) at full budget; V3-EXQ-859 tested the lateral_pfc-vs-none sweep but only at SHORT budget (P0=10 vs this run's P0=200); no manifest anywhere sweeps route_source at matched seeds AND full training budget. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. See REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md (+.json) for the full autopsy this replication answers, and experiments/v3_exq_859_arc062_lateral_pfc_route_mech448_449_ablation.py / experiments/v3_exq_851_arc062_pa_lateral_pfc_route_source_gapfanout.py for the two scripts this one merges.
